[1/3] Add failing-first tests for a non-finite float argument to float() and for sequence concatenation over the cap, then guard both. [2/3] Record ADR-009, update README and the codebase map. [3/3] Run the full pebble suite and aikit check, then complete the task.

impact_assessment.why: The analysis found two residual contract gaps: float() returns an already non-finite float unchanged even though ADR-004 says non-finite results are refused, and string/list + bypasses MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH so concatenation can grow without bound while repetition and ranges are capped.
impact_assessment.benefits: The conversion builtins share one non-finite contract for embedders, and every user-visible sequence constructor now respects the same 1,000,000-value memory bound.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: string/list concatenation over the cap now raises a positioned EvalError and float(inf/nan) is refused; dependency: none, standard library math only; concurrency: none, single-threaded interpreter; state: no files or schemas change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for both guards, a patched-cap test that stays fast, direct-call coverage for inf/-inf/nan, ADR-009, README/map sync, and the full aikit check pebble gate.

[1/5] Plan: add four text builtins (split, join, trim, replace) under a new ADR-010, pinned by failing-first tests, then sync README, map and examples

impact_assessment.why: Pebble can read script arguments but cannot shape text: no split, join, trim or replace, so every real text-processing script is impossible even though strings are a first-class value.
impact_assessment.benefits: Scripts can tokenize arguments and files, reassemble fields, clean whitespace and rewrite fragments with four small, guarded builtins instead of hand-written while-loop slicing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: surface grows to 14 builtins and ADR-002's builtin contract list is amended; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: none, single-threaded interpreter; state: no files or schemas change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: ADR-010 pins every arity, type rule, whitespace set and length cap before code; failing-first tests per builtin; reuse MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH; full aikit check pebble gate.

[1/4] Plan: add one list builtin, sort(values), ascending and stable, reusing min/max ordering rules, recorded as ADR-011 and pinned by failing-first tests, then sync README, map and examples

impact_assessment.why: Pebble can take the minimum and maximum of a set but cannot order it: every list-shaped result, such as split's fields, cannot be ranked except with a hand-written nested loop, which is the one list operation scripts still write by hand.
impact_assessment.benefits: Scripts can order fields, scores and names in one call and reach descending order with the existing slice syntax, sort(x)[::-1], so no direction argument is needed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: surface grows to 15 builtins and ADR-002's list is amended; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: none, single-threaded interpreter; state: no files or schemas change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: ADR-011 pins the ordering, stability and refusal rules before code; failing-first tests for numbers, strings, stability, mixed and unorderable values, and arity; full aikit check pebble gate.

[1/5] Plan: add four text builtins (upper, lower, contains, find) under ADR-012, with Unicode-aware case folding, an empty-search refusal shared with split/replace, and find returning none when absent; failing-first tests first

impact_assessment.why: Pebble can cut, join, trim, rewrite and order text but cannot compare it case-insensitively or ask whether one string occurs inside another, so every search or match still needs a hand-written index loop.
impact_assessment.benefits: Scripts can normalise case, test membership in one call and locate a fragment without a sentinel that collides with negative indexing, composing with split, join and sort.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: surface grows to 19 builtins and ADR-002's list is amended; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: none, single-threaded interpreter; state: no files or schemas change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: ADR-012 pins case mapping, the empty-search rule, the none result and the length cap before code; failing-first tests per builtin; reuse MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH; full aikit check pebble gate.
